t: A tiny, fully open FPGA stick for learning digital logic on a breadboard.
steps: Buy the UPduino v3.1 from the tinyVision.ai store, Tindie or Lectronz for about 36 US dollars.
Get a micro USB cable, as one is not included.
Solder on the two headers, or pay extra for soldered headers.
Install IceStudio or APIO on your computer.
Pick the upduino3 board in the app.
Build the blink example and upload it over USB.
Try a button and LED example on a breadboard next.
meta: Wild Open. From $36. A few stores.
